guardrails: Explicit invocation only. Never load for a request that does not name the gauntlet.
While a run is active this plugin sits at the top of the stack and supersedes overlapping skills.
The router may not report completion and may not skip verification to reach the report.
Caps pause, they never certify. A capped piece is never done.
Consensus is computed by scripts/consensus.py, never by a model.
Handoffs are generated from state by scripts/write_handoff.py; agent opinion is confined to the labeled judgment section.
